description: This file contains functions and interfaces for validating form submissions, checking for duplicate responses, and extracting submitter information within a booking and routing form context.

methods.name: shouldTriggerFormSubmittedNoEvent
methods.description: Determines if the form submission trigger should be skipped based on existing bookings or duplicate submissions.

methods.name: getSubmitterEmail
methods.description: Extracts the submitter's email address from form responses.

methods.name: getSubmitterName
methods.description: Extracts the submitter's name from form responses, prioritizing 'name', 'firstName', then 'lastName'.

methods.name: hasDuplicateSubmission
methods.description: Checks if a duplicate form response exists within the last 60 minutes based on email.
